paragraphs.text: BOOK 1 Commencing with the invocation of God, Augustine relates in detail the beginning of his life, his infancy and boyhood, up to his fifteenth year; at which age he acknowledges that he was more inclined to all youthful pleasures and vices than to the study of letters.

BOOK 2 He advances to puberty, and indeed to the early part of the sixteenth year of his age, in which, having abandoned his studies, he indulged in lustful pleasures, and, with his companions, committed theft.

BOOK 3 Of the seventeenth, eighteenth, and nineteenth years of his age, passed at Carthage, when, having completed his course of studies, he is caught in the snares of a licentious passion, and falls into the errors of the Manichaeans.

BOOK 4 Then follows a period of nine years from the nineteenth year of his age, during which having lost a friend, he followed the Manichaeans -- and wrote books on the fair and fit, and published a work on the liberal arts, and the categories of Aristotle.

BOOK 5 He describes the twenty-ninth year of his age, in which, having discovered the fallacies of the Manichaeans, he professed rhetoric at Rome and Milan. Having heard Ambrose, he begins to come to himself.

BOOK 6 Attaining his thirtieth year, he, under the admonition of the discourses of Ambrose, discovered more and more the truth of the Catholic doctrine, and deliberates as to the better regulation of his life.

BOOK 7 He recalls the beginning of his youth, i.e. the thirty-first year of his age, in which very grave errors as to the nature of God and the origin of evil being distinguished, and the sacred books more accurately known, he at length arrives at a clear knowledge of God, not yet rightly apprehending Jesus Christ.

BOOK 8 He finally describes the thirty-second year of his age, the most memorable of his whole life, in which, being instructed by Simplicianus concerning the conversion of others, and the manner of acting, he is, after a severe struggle, renewed in his whole mind, and is converted unto God.

BOOK 9 He speaks of his design of forsaking the profession of rhetoric; of the death of his friends, Nebridius and Verecundus; of having received baptism in the thirty-third year of his age; and of the virtues and death of his mother, Monica.

BOOK 10 Having manifested what he was and what he is, he shows the great fruit of his confession; and being about to examine by what method God and the happy life may be found, he enlarges on the nature and power of memory. Then he examines his own acts, thoughts and affections, viewed under the threefold division of temptation; and commemorates the Lord, the one mediator of God and men.

BOOK 11 The design of his confessions being declared, he seeks from God the knowledge of the Holy Scriptures, and begins to expound the words of Genesis 1:1, concerning the creation of the world. The questions of rash disputers being refuted, "what did God before he created the world?" that he might the better overcome his opponents, he adds a copious disquisition concerning time.

BOOK 12 He continues his explanation of the first chapter of Genesis according to the Septuagint, and by its assistance he argues, especially, concerning the double Heaven, and the formless matter out of which the whole world may have been created; afterwards of the interpretations of others not disallowed, and sets forth at great length the sense of the Holy Scripture.

BOOK 13 Of the goodness of God explained in the creation of things, and of the Trinity as found in the first words of Genesis. The story concerning the origin of the world (Genesis 1) is allegorically explained, and he applies it to those things which God works for sanctified and blessed man. Finally, he makes an end of this work, having implored eternal rest from God.

latex.p0002: \Emph{第一卷} 以呼求天主开始，\Person{奥思定}详细叙述了他生命的最初阶段，他的婴儿期和童年，直到他十五岁；在那个年龄，他承认自己更倾向于所有青春的享乐和恶习，而非潜心研读。
latex.p0003: \Emph{第二卷} 他进入青春期，确切地说是他十六岁的最初阶段，在此期间，他放弃了学业，沉溺于肉欲的享乐，并伙同同伴犯了盗窃罪。
latex.p0004: \Emph{第三卷} 叙述他十七、十八及十九岁时，在\Place{迦太基}度过的岁月，那时，他完成了学业课程，却陷入放纵情欲的网罗，并堕入了\OriginalTerm{摩尼教徒}{Manichaeans}的错谬之中。
latex.p0005: \Emph{第四卷} 继之叙述从他十九岁开始的九年时光，在此期间，他失去了一位朋友，追随了\OriginalTerm{摩尼教徒}{Manichaeans}——并撰写了\WorkTitle{论美与适宜}一书，还发表了一部论\OriginalTerm{自由艺术}{liberal arts}的著作，以及\Person{亚里士多德}的\OriginalTerm{范畴}{categories}。
latex.p0006: \Emph{第五卷} 他描述了自己二十九岁时的经历，那时他发现了\OriginalTerm{摩尼教徒}{Manichaeans}的谬误，在\Place{罗马}和\Place{米兰}教授修辞学。在聆听了\Person{安波罗修}的讲道后，他开始恢复理智。
latex.p0007: \Emph{第六卷} 到了三十岁，他在\Person{安波罗修}讲道的劝诫下，越来越多地发现了\OriginalTerm{天主教教义}{Catholic doctrine}的真理，并思量如何更好地规范自己的生活。
latex.p0008: \Emph{第七卷} 他回顾了自己青年期的开始，即三十一岁时，在这一时期，他辨析了关于天主的本性及恶的起源的极其严重的错误，并且更准确地认识了\OriginalTerm{圣经}{sacred books}，最终获得了对天主的清晰认识，尽管尚未正确领悟\Person{耶稣基督}。
latex.p0009: \Emph{第八卷} 他最后描述了自己三十二岁时的经历，这是他整个生命中最值得纪念的一年，在这一年里，\Person{辛普利齐亚努斯}就他人的皈依及行事方式给予他指导，经过一番艰苦的斗争后，他的整个心灵得以更新，并皈依了天主。
latex.p0010: \Emph{第九卷} 他讲到自己放弃修辞学职业的计划；谈到他朋友\Person{内布里迪乌斯}和\Person{维雷孔杜斯}的去世；述说他在三十三岁时领受了\OriginalTerm{圣洗}{baptism}；以及他母亲\Person{莫尼加}的德行与逝世。
latex.p0011: \Emph{第十卷} 在揭示了自己过去的和现在的状况后，他展示了其忏悔的伟大成果；他准备探讨通过何种方法可以寻获天主和幸福的生活，便详论了记忆的本性与能力。然后，他按照诱惑的三重划分，省察了自己的行为、思想和情感；并记念主，那位天主与人之间的唯一中保。
latex.p0012: \Emph{第十一卷} 阐明了其忏悔书的主题后，他向天主寻求对\OriginalTerm{圣经}{Holy Scriptures}的认识，并开始解释\BibleRef{创 1:1}的经文，即关于世界的创造。在驳斥了那些轻率辩难者的问题——\Quote{在天主创造世界之前，天主在做什么？}——之后，为了更好地克胜对手，他又加上了一篇关于时间的详尽探讨。
latex.p0013: \Emph{第十二卷} 他依照\WorkTitle{七十贤士译本}继续解释\BibleRef{创 1}，并借助它特别论证了\OriginalTerm{双重天}{double Heaven}，以及那可能用以创造整个世界的\OriginalTerm{无形物质}{formless matter}；随后，他又谈论了那些未被否定的他人解释，并详尽地阐述了\OriginalTerm{圣经}{Holy Scripture}的意义。
latex.p0014: \Emph{第十三卷} 论述了在万物的创造中所显明的天主的美善，以及在\BibleRef{创 1:1}中所启示的\OriginalTerm{天主圣三}{Trinity}。关于世界起源的故事（\BibleRef{创 1}）被寓义性地解释，他将其应用到天主为圣化并祝福人所做的工作上。最后，他在祈求天主赐予永恒安息之后，结束了这部著作。
